description: CloudFormation RDS instance with a hardcoded MasterUserPassword
note: The literal credential, which is the goal spec §2 measured at 75% before the secrets framework was switched on. Worth contrasting with the Terraform case: CKV_SECRET_6 misses that one because its password contains a '!', and catches this one, so the labelled gap is about the value and not the language. Trivy raises six RDS misconfigurations on this file (AWS-0077/0080/0133/0176/0177/0180, including unencrypted storage and PubliclyAccessible) and nothing about the secret.
